world_model_changes.text: Question: can complete supplied knowledge become reliable consequences, and does a record of choices help beyond cheap alternatives? Method: compare both base/archive reader families with exact execution and a uniform floor on the same constructed worlds; compare complete archived-reader assistance profiles; evaluate original feature models on separately partitioned, historically exposed human revisions. The selected work separates having the complete instructions from reliably using them, and interactive action from whole-process generation. Explicit execution predicts consequences better than direct reading of the same complete program in every tested package. The archived readers differ in how long they sustain named actions, so the first package's short horizon does not generalize to both. Neither passes the supplied finite-rule consistency battery. On the human revision corpus, lexical features add small retrospective annotation gains but do not establish an advantage over cheap rivals for forecasting the next cycle. These observations refine the tested interfaces; they do not identify an internal learning mechanism or validate general inference of a maker's intentions.

competence.text: The exact executor supplies consequences from privileged law and state. Both base and archived neural packages lag it on direct full-information prediction; adding code helps the archived packages relative to code omission, without eliminating that gap. Under stepwise environment checking, archived Qwen benefits from offered actions and shorter true-state resets, while archived SmolLM sustains freely named actions through the tested horizon on nearly all assigned worlds. Neither result establishes correct stopping or uninterrupted whole-log generation. Both supplied finite-rule packages fail complete paired correctness. Local repair, new training, transfer and broader generation operations were deferred. Numerical scorer calibration does not calibrate generation precision.

maker.text: This tranche does not test recovery of an individual maker's persistent purposes or values. The constructed comparisons supply operative information; their executor is not inferring a hidden maker. The human task predicts recorded revision annotations with fitted feature models. Lexical features add only a small retrospective increment. Neither future lexical view clearly beats its development-selected cheap rival, and adding the earlier record worsens the future forecast relative to the earlier draft alone. This limits the tested representation and corpus; it does not show that the maker lacks a continuing purpose or that the record contains no useful information.

substrates.text: Scientific coverage consists of constructed essay/workshop worlds and historically exposed student-essay revisions. The constructed artifact-action prompt fails in both archived packages; this is a failure of those interfaces, not proof that finished artifacts lack process information. The human retrospective task reads a known annotated span, its revision pair or assisted record; it is not unrestricted interpretation of an entire finished essay. Human selections, genetic editions, code, visual work and other declared substrates remain outside this selected scientific run. Readiness must be reported separately from scientific execution.

confirmations.text: No new confirmation reserve was opened. All reported comparisons are discovery descriptions with pointwise intervals, shared cohorts and retained failures. Both original audit attempts failed and the original packet remains NOT RUN WITH REASON. Under separately authorized repair, the complete original evidence ledger now reconstructs exactly in a fresh process. The overnight byte index and all applicable scoped control, provenance, calibration and profile reviews are reconciled. This separate scoped closeout reports the selected observations; it does not rewrite those failures, complete the full stage or admit any reader under the historical whole-generation criterion.

limitations.text: The packages share the same constructed worlds and are not independent population replications. Base/archive comparisons do not isolate a causal training effect, model size or architecture. Rollout action counts do not measure policy quality or correct stopping. Missing genuine reset states remain in assigned denominators, so reset penalties do not isolate harmful information. Altered-history mean-score intervals crossing zero do not prove distributional invariance. Generated histories supply no adequately supported matched-state population comparison. Finite-rule aliases are grouped into distinct projections, and ties earn no categorical correctness credit. The human corpus is historically exposed, its annotations are not governing intentions, and its lexical extractor is bounded.

pursuit.text: The broader pursuit remains a reader that can use production knowledge to recover observable parts of a maker's choices. The next useful question is which assistance converts the observed operational skills into a valid bounded inference task, with a strong cheap rival and independent recorded truth. Further work should select a complete, affordable branch from the commissioned agenda, preserving its original sample and validity requirements. This packet itself does not authorize that continuation.

warrant.text: Current warrant is package-specific matched-information diagnosis, bounded interactive execution, failed supplied-rule consistency, and task-specific human annotation prediction. It does not establish ordinary artifact-to-maker recovery, an internal surface-only or expertise mechanism, a universal inability of neural readers, or human value inference. The positive and negative observations coexist because they concern different operations and assistance.

strongest_rival.text: Task interface, assistance and representation limits remain the strongest competing explanation for the capability pattern. Explicit execution has an architectural advantage in carrying out the supplied program, but the direct-reader deficit does not identify its internal cause. Strong cheap features and annotation composition can explain much of the human task. Any later mechanism claim must distinguish those explanations on a task with an independently verified information boundary.

next_decision.text: Recommendation: review these completed selected findings before choosing one further bounded inference branch; keep the remaining Stage 9 agenda explicitly deferred. The real objection is that this tranche supplies mostly diagnosis and little direct evidence of individual-maker inference. A follow-up should name one inference target, use a reader competent for that operation, include its strongest cheap rival and declare a realistic resource limit. This is an analyst recommendation for discussion, not curator ratification or authorization to execute another stage.

original_claims.statement: Explicit execution outpredicts direct reading of the same complete supplied program/state in all four pinned packages on shared discovery questions. Direct reading remains below the uniform floor pooled; code addition helps archived packages only at the resolved-interval level. Privileged consequence diagnosis, not ordinary maker recovery or a causal training/mechanism claim.

Lexical features add small retrospective annotation gains; neither future view has a resolved advantage over its development-selected cheap rival, and the earlier record worsens forecast relative to the earlier draft alone. Exposed corpus, bounded features and annotation targets; no new confirmation or governing-intention inference.

overnight_claims.statement: The complete two-archive grid distinguishes assisted interactive action, fixed-state history prediction and supplied finite-rule consistency. Named-action horizons differ by package; artifact interfaces fail, neither archive passes the complete finite-rule batteries, and generated-history matches cannot support a population contrast. No full-generator, correct-stopping, internal-mechanism, human or confirmation claim.

local_repair.absent_reason: No local-repair operation was selected for scientific execution. A genuine-state reset is supplied assistance, not an inferred repair. No eligible selected-scope case is established.

selected.description: In a constructed workshop_doc world, archived smollm using artifact_environment failed at interaction 1: invalid visible action or repeated completed action. Its first response line at that interaction was '0 check the order done'. This is the first invalid generated action within a stepwise attempt, not a verdict on the original uninterrupted whole-log generation test; STOP and unavailable genuine resets are excluded from this illustration type and remain reported separately.

maker_signature.absent_reason: No individual-adaptation or maker-signature comparison was selected. Annotation prediction and supplied known state do not establish a predictable individual signature.

unsupported_explanation.absent_reason: No selected scientific task assessed explanation confidence against prospective consequences. Invalid actions and self-produced outcomes are not silently reclassified as confident explanations.

selected.description: In a constructed essay world, archived qwen reached eight legal actions when genuine state was restored every four interactions; the matched uninterrupted run did not reach eight. The reset was available in this case. This illustrates supplied-state assistance, not ordinary biography, maker inference or a benefit at every horizon; all losses, ties and unavailable resets remain in the complete comparison.

false_context.absent_reason: No selected false-context intervention jointly measured confidence and unseen-choice accuracy. Unavailable genuine resets are retained construction failures, not planted false context.

ambiguity.absent_reason: The selected work has equivalent finite futures and sparse matched-history comparisons, but no scored posterior over rival maker histories establishing persistent inferential ambiguity. Missing contrasts and binary rule equivalence are not substituted for this case type.

selected.description: On a constructed essay next-action question, the qwen archive reader saw the complete operative program and state but assigned the realized action less probability than the uniform distribution over all 19 offered actions, including STOP. The model-free uniform floor wins on this question; the separately reported exact executor has privileged law/state and is a consequence benchmark. This fixed-seed illustration is drawn from every such loss across all four packages, not selected by its magnitude.

case_population_review.basis: All 192 assigned worlds in every selected rollout condition for both archives and all four supplied-information packages were inspected from committed units. Eligibility is descriptive and chosen by the coding operator before applying the original fixed-seed illustration selector; it is not a new statistical test or a prospective scientific preregistration. First invalid stepwise generation attempts, reset benefits at the already reported eight-action horizon, and all uniform-floor victories supply present types. Five untested or non-equivalent types retain explicit absence. Repeated package/condition observations share their original independent groups; no population sample inflation. No scores or original outputs changed.

X01.expected_response: Changed inputs, discarded-fit substitution or sample subsetting must refuse; repeated source aliases must not become new independent observations.
X01.existing_evidence_basis: Launch retains original cases/prerequisites and package identities. Actual producer inspections reconstruct every assigned source unit; finite projections retain their alias memberships. The exact selected graph and all original output bindings are checked in the completed index.

X02.limits: Uses the existing fixed-layout storage inspection and its compatible-inventory crosscheck; it is not a newly generalized storage or operating-system isolation audit. Supplied laws and true-state resets are declared assistance.

X03.scope: Maker-proxy attacks versus fixed-package competence and matched-prefix questions.
X03.expected_response: A competence result must not be promoted to maker-specific evidence from topic, wording, length or device. A matched-history comparison must preserve its operative state and declared information.
X03.existing_evidence_basis: The extension contains no maker assignment or individual-benefit estimand. Existing matched-history tests check full state, and complete producer/profile reconstruction retains domains and original source groups.
X03.limits: No new proxy-ablation campaign is claimed. Effects remain conditional on these domains, interfaces and fixed prompt rendering; wording independence is not established.

X04.expected_response: A maker-context claim would require correctly grouped wrong-person/shuffled controls.
X04.existing_evidence_basis: No extension job assigns individual makers or tests a maker-context benefit. Those original branches remain deferred in the full card ledger.
X04.limits: The absence is specific to this selected scope, not evidence that a maker-shuffle attack passed.

X05.scope: Aliases, repeated steps, paired families and shared source groups.
X05.expected_response: Renamed source identities must not inflate finite projection counts; rollout steps and repeated conditions must not be treated as independent participants.

X05.limits: The families and interfaces reuse the same worlds; their counts cannot be summed into independent replications. No human-population inference is licensed.

X06.expected_response: Missing support/subsets or changed outputs refuse. Illegal actions, malformed stories and early stopping cannot count as sustained success; failed components and missing generated matches remain visible.
X06.existing_evidence_basis: The original exact/blind/malformed/partial fixtures cover execution interfaces, complete artifact support, stop/clock handling and diagnostic propagation. Actual producer and complete profile inspections preserve all original calls and units.
X06.limits: Candidate-order or wording invariance is not inferred from these fixed-rendering checks. Report conditional performance and retain ties, invalidity, missing matches and realized-support limits.

X07.expected_response: An out-of-envelope scorer must not silently pass its original tolerance; amended tolerance and historical failure remain distinct and package-bound.
X07.existing_evidence_basis: All six selected calibration consumers were reconstructed against the original exact-package calibration records and target produces. The completed index preserves those bindings and original failures.
X07.limits: Likelihood-scoring calibration is not a generation-precision experiment. No unmeasured batch, device or arithmetic robustness is asserted for generated action strings.

X08.scope: Actual state resets and matched histories; unselected purpose interventions.
X08.expected_response: A purported reset must replace the actual learner history with the true state; matched histories must preserve full state. Changes in assistance or information must remain explicit.
X08.existing_evidence_basis: Existing tests verify genuine resets, legal alternative histories, state preservation, environment outcome supply and non-repair of invalid actions. The complete observed rows/profiles are reconstructed for both families.
X08.limits: Offered actions, supplied outcomes, resets and artifact-only views are different information/interaction conditions, not a single pure mechanism manipulation. No purpose-changing intervention was executed in this extension.

X09.scope: Explanatory fluency and false-context confidence claims.
X09.expected_response: A fluent explanation cannot substitute for prospective utility or legal execution; harmful false-context confidence needs its own actual comparison.
X09.existing_evidence_basis: The story/clock/early-stop controls reject fluency as sustained action success. The extension did not execute an explanation-confidence or false-context experiment.
X09.limits: Do not count generated incorrect outcomes as the preselected harmful-false-context experiment, and do not invent an eligible example for that case type.

X10.scope: Finite equivalence, distinguishing histories and ambiguity; unselected proposal-family claims.
X10.expected_response: Equivalent histories must have identical exact continuations; declared distinctions must be realized. Constant/invalid answers and ties must not pass the complete paired criterion.
X10.existing_evidence_basis: Exact finite-world and query fixtures exhaustively verify the compact rules against both constructor domains, and test longer distinctions, commuting histories, constant readers and invalid readers. Projection-aware final profiles retain these criteria.
X10.limits: This supplies finite laws; it does not establish a learned internal state representation or calibrated confidence. Proposal-family adequacy and unique maker attribution remain outside the selected extension.

X11.expected_response: A pooled figure cannot replace separate family/domain outcomes, suppress missing matches or imply a training-seed factorial that did not run.
X11.existing_evidence_basis: Both complete family profiles preserve domain groups, all declared horizons, finite groups and missing generated matches; the index retains all fourteen producers, six checks and six profiles without dropping losing branches.
X11.limits: Only the two existing archived packages were used; no newly trained multi-seed comparison or complete original factorial is claimed. Small or absent matched populations remain explicit.

X12.expected_response: A competing writer must refuse; resume must preserve prior bytes, cell identity and clock without duplicating units or dropping costs. Completion requires the whole committed scope.

Current continuation validation has explicit source compatibility. The actual overnight terminal inspection verifies all original process exits and attempts; the checked index retains the original failed audits, unrun packet and attempt ledger.

The separately authorized original-ledger reproduction is exact, and separate scoped packet validation is complete; the original packet job remains not run.
